summary_md:
# Anthropic på børsen - køb eller vent?

**Feed**: store-penge  
**Published**: 2026-11-12  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This episode of the Danish podcast Store Penge is mostly about Anthropic's upcoming IPO. Host Mikkel Rosenvold is extremely bullish and expects Claude to replace SaaS software. Tobias Storm also plans to take a position, though he warns that Google and Meta have much larger cash flows. The panel expects a 25bp Fed hike in December, possibly followed by a Christmas rally. They see the beaten-down AI names (IREN, CoreWeave, Rocket Lab, HPE) as attractive, with strong compute demand and SanDisk's buybacks taken as signs of a bottom, but they are negative on SaaS stocks such as Salesforce and ServiceNow.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 HPE — Hewlett Packard Enterprise | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Guest Tobias bought DKK 154k on Monday; pure AI-infrastructure exposure; P/E fell from mid-40s to low 20s.

#### Reasoning

Tobias argues that after the split, HPE is a pure play on AI data-center infrastructure, without the weak PC business that hurts Intel and Dell. Intel's report showed AI infrastructure demand growing faster than expected. The valuation has fallen to a P/E in the low 20s and he sees more upside. Mikkel agrees that going further down the value chain makes sense.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI data-center infrastructure demand slows
- if valuation re-rates back to mid-40s P/E without earnings growth

> *"Ja, altså det er Hewlett Packard Enterprise, som jeg har lavet et opkøb i på de her 154.000 kroner her om mandag"*

---

### ⛔ CRM — Salesforce | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Mikkel expects Claude to eat SaaS; Tobias has sold his Salesforce shares and cut software exposure.

#### Reasoning

Mikkel argues Claude will become the 'Windows' operating layer, so SaaS products like CRM end up sold as MCP services inside Claude, which hurts subscription economics. Tobias has sold Salesforce for similar reasons and wants to avoid the software and service sector.

#### Sell Triggers

- if SaaS vendors successfully integrate into AI platforms without margin loss
- if AI adoption in enterprise workflows stalls

> *"faktisk også så lyder Salesforce og Trimmy ServiceNow også af nogle af de årsager"*

---

### 🔴 NOW — ServiceNow | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Tobias trimmed his ServiceNow position because of the AI/Claude disruption risk to software.

#### Reasoning

Part of a broader cut in software exposure: Tobias believes AI agents will replace SaaS workflows and wants little exposure to the software and service sector.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI disruption of SaaS proves slower than expected

> *"Jeg har også reduceret min software-eksmunering"*

---

### 🟠 CRWV — CoreWeave | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Sales +168% y/y, stock +16% after the report; neoclouds may have a comeback ahead; debt and financing are the risk.

#### Reasoning

Tobias sees compute demand as close to insatiable, with supply as the only bottleneck. Neocloud stocks have been hit hard but may rebound. Mikkel points to debt and financing as the main risk, and the market questions how durable long-term compute demand is.

#### Sell Triggers

- if financing costs or debt become unsustainable
- if compute demand weakens in 1-5 years

> *"de her cloud-aktier og neocloud-aktier, de måske har et godt comeback at løbe på"*

---

### 🟠 IREN — IREN | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

AI compute revenue rising strongly; able to double H100 rental prices.

#### Reasoning

Tobias highlights the pricing power: IREN doubled rental prices on older H100 chips while demand stayed strong, which suggests the compute market is supply-constrained. He calls this positive for IREN and other neoclouds; the risk is debt-funded data-center buildout.

#### Sell Triggers

- if compute pricing falls
- if financing of data centers becomes strained

> *"Så det synes jeg er rigtig positivt for både en virksomhed som iRent"*

---

### 🟠 RKLB — Rocket Lab | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Record backlog and revenue beat; Neutron delayed to 2027; 2027 could be a recovery year for space stocks.

#### Reasoning

Tobias notes the record order book and the stronger-than-expected revenue. He thinks Democratic support for NASA could revive the space sector in 2027 after heavy sell-offs. The Neutron delay is a negative.

#### Sell Triggers

- further Neutron delays
- if NASA/space funding does not increase

> *"2027 bliver en potentiel opgang period for space-aktierne"*

---

### 🟠 SNDK — SanDisk | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Very large buyback at ~3-4x P/E, seen as a sign of a bottom in AI stocks.

#### Reasoning

Mikkel reads the buyback as management confidence and a classic bottoming signal, with the stock trading at a very low P/E.

#### Sell Triggers

- if memory demand collapses

> *"Det plejer i hvert fald at være et meget godt tegn på, at der er noget bund i det."*

---
